hints: Write $z=x+iy$ and make the quotient real by multiplying numerator and denominator by the conjugate of $z-5$.
Set the imaginary part of the resulting numerator equal to zero to obtain a linear relation between $x$ and $y$.
Combine that relation with $x^2+y^2=17$ from the modulus condition.
Solve for both coordinate pairs and substitute them into the original quotient to confirm it is defined and real.
walkthrough:
Let $z = x + \mathrm{i}y$, where $x, y \in \mathbb{R}$. Express the numerator and denominator in Cartesian form:
$$z + 5\mathrm{i} = x + \mathrm{i}(y + 5)$$
$$z - 5 = (x - 5) + \mathrm{i}y$$

Multiply the numerator and denominator by the complex conjugate of the denominator, $(x - 5) - \mathrm{i}y$:
$$\dfrac{z + 5\mathrm{i}}{z - 5} = \dfrac{[x + \mathrm{i}(y + 5)][(x - 5) - \mathrm{i}y]}{[(x - 5) + \mathrm{i}y][(x - 5) - \mathrm{i}y]}$$
$$\text{Denominator } = (x - 5)^2 + y^2$$

Expand the numerator and separate into real and imaginary parts:
$$\text{Numerator} = x(x - 5) - \mathrm{i}xy + \mathrm{i}(y + 5)(x - 5) - \mathrm{i}^2y(y + 5)$$
$$= [x^2 - 5x + y(y + 5)] + \mathrm{i}[(y + 5)(x - 5) - xy]$$
$$= [x^2 - 5x + y^2 + 5y] + \mathrm{i}[xy - 5y + 5x - 25 - xy]$$
$$= [x^2 - 5x + y^2 + 5y] + \mathrm{i}[5x - 5y - 25]$$

Set the imaginary part of the numerator to zero since the quotient is real:
$$5x - 5y - 25 = 0$$
$$\text{Divide by 5: } \quad x - y - 5 = 0 \implies y = x - 5 \quad \text{--- (1)}$$

Use the modulus condition $|z| = \sqrt{17}$ to form a second equation:
$$|z|^2 = x^2 + y^2 = (\sqrt{17})^2 = 17 \quad \text{--- (2)}$$

Substitute equation (1) $y = x - 5$ into equation (2) and expand:
$$x^2 + (x - 5)^2 = 17$$
$$x^2 + (x^2 - 10x + 25) = 17$$
$$2x^2 - 10x + 25 - 17 = 0$$
$$2x^2 - 10x + 8 = 0$$
$$\text{Divide throughout by 2: } \quad x^2 - 5x + 4 = 0$$
$$(x - 4)(x - 1) = 0$$
$$x = 4 \quad \text{or} \quad x = 1$$

Calculate the corresponding values of $y$ using $y = x - 5$:
$$\text{When } x = 4: \quad y = 4 - 5 = -1 \implies z = 4 - \mathrm{i}$$
$$\text{When } x = 1: \quad y = 1 - 5 = -4 \implies z = 1 - 4\mathrm{i}$$
$$\text{Both denominators } (4 - 5)^2 + (-1)^2 = 2 \neq 0 \text{ and } (1 - 5)^2 + (-4)^2 = 32 \neq 0 \text{ are non-zero.}$$

State the required complex numbers in the form $x + \mathrm{i}y$:
$$z = 4 - \mathrm{i} \quad \text{or} \quad z = 1 - 4\mathrm{i}$$
